prerequisites.label: python3 on PATH (the interpreter the Launcher and its verify.sh run under)
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Python 3. Mac: brew install python@3.12. VPS: ships in the container image.

prerequisites.label: Python package jsonschema>=4.0 importable by python3 with the shared pydeps folder first on sys.path (the Skill 79 checkout validator imports it at module load; Skills 49, 71, 78-82, 44 and 38 reach it too)
prerequisites.satisfy: Run from the 83-black-friday-launcher folder: python3 -m launcher_core.cli dependencies --install. It installs into <root>/pydeps/py<X.Y>/ with pip --target (the one install an externally-managed Python accepts); never --break-system-packages, never a venv. The installer, every update-skills.sh roll and the launcher itself (before it builds anything) do this for you; run bash update-skills.sh --prereqs-check to see whether this box has it. This entry's pythonModule and requirement keys are what oc_ensure_jsonschema (lib-onboarding-state.sh) reads.
